title: Round467 first-five hybrid fresh opponent league audit
status: Completed · exploratory only; mixed transfer evidence
method: Raw PPO and first-five Max Damage hybrid were evaluated on identical generated teams, Round402 selector previews, repeat indices, and side-swapped games. Each opponent screen used 256 team-pair clusters with two repeated outcomes (1,024 games per arm). Paired 95% intervals use 10,000 bootstrap resamples over team clusters. Showdown battle RNG is server-side, so the outcome randomness is not identical between arms.
intervention: For the evaluated Round467 policy only, replace decision indices 0–4 with the legal Max Damage scorer; then return to masked PPO policy logits.
interpretation: The override transfers positively against a random policy and Round430 PPO, but significantly regresses against the legacy Counterplay heuristic. It is opponent-sensitive and should not be called generally stronger, robust, or optimal. A larger league or mixed-policy training objective is needed before promoting it. The win-probability head was not used to select actions.
runtime_note: Eight-worker evaluation throughput was 9.01/10.07 games/s raw/hybrid vs Random, 6.14/7.49 vs legacy Counterplay, and 3.53/7.20 vs Round430 PPO. One raw PPO-vs-PPO worker took 290 s while the others were about 115 s, showing long-tail batch cost. Treat these as workload-dependent evaluation rates, not training rollout throughput.
bootstrap_report: Each opponent directory contains hybrid_minus_raw.json; detailed paired summaries and worker logs are in the local training output directory listed by artifact_prefix.
